pairs: Omnis qui credit quoniam Jesus est Christus,
Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ,
Et omnis qui diligit eum qui genuit,
et eum qui natus est ex eo.
also loves him who has been born of God.
In hoc cognoscimus quoniam diligamus natos Dei,
we know that we love those born of God:
when we love God and do his commandments.
For this is the love of God:
et mandata ejus gravia non sunt.
And his commandments are not heavy.
Quoniam omne quod natum est ex Deo, vincit mundum:
For all that is born of God overcomes the world.
et hæc est victoria, quæ vincit mundum,
And this is the victory that overcomes the world:
Who is it that overcomes the world?
nisi qui credit quoniam Jesus est Filius Dei?
Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God!
This is the One who came by water
qui venit per aquam et sanguinem,
qui testificatur quoniam Christus est veritas.
And the Spirit is the One who testifies that the Christ is the Truth.
Quoniam tres sunt, qui testimonium dant in cælo:
For there are Three who give testimony in heaven:
Et tres sunt, qui testimonium dant in terra:
And there are three who give testimony on earth:
If we accept the testimony of men,
then the testimony of God is greater.
For this is the testimony of God,
quoniam testificatus est de Filio suo.
that he has testified about his Son.
Whoever believes in the Son of God,
holds the testimony of God within himself.
Whoever does not believe in the Son,
quia non credit in testimonium quod testificatus est Deus de Filio suo.
because he does not believe in the testimony which God has testified about his Son.
And this is the testimony which God has given to us:
quoniam vitam æternam dedit nobis Deus:
et hæc vita in Filio ejus est.
And this Life is in his Son.
Whoever does not have the Son,
Hæc scribo vobis ut sciatis quoniam vitam habetis æternam,
I am writing this to you, so that you may know that you have Eternal Life:
qui creditis in nomine Filii Dei.
you who believe in the name of the Son of God.
Et hæc est fiducia, quam habemus ad eum:
And this is the confidence which we have toward God:
that no matter what we shall request,
Et scimus quia audit nos quidquid petierimus:
And we know that he hears us, no matter what we request;
scimus quoniam habemus petitiones quas postulamus ab eo.
so we know that we can obtain the things that we request of him.
Qui scit fratrem suum peccare peccatum non ad mortem,
Anyone who realizes that his brother has sinned, with a sin that is not unto death,
et dabitur ei vita peccanti non ad mortem.
and life shall be given to him who has sinned not unto death.
There is a sin which is unto death.
non pro illo dico ut roget quis.
I am not saying that anyone should ask on behalf of that sin.
All that is iniquity is sin.
But there is a sin unto death.
Scimus quia omnis qui natus est ex Deo,
We know that everyone who is born of God does not sin.
and the evil one cannot touch him.
We know that we are of God,
et mundus totus in maligno positus est.
and that the entire world is established in wickedness.
Et scimus quoniam Filius Dei venit,
And we know that the Son of God has arrived,
et dedit nobis sensum ut cognoscamus verum Deum,
and that he has given us understanding, so that we may know the true God,
et simus in vero Filio ejus.
and so that we may remain in his true Son.
Hic est verus Deus, et vita æterna.
This is the true God, and this is Eternal Life.
